title: Dual Keres Prime
extract:
Dual Keres Prime are the primed variant of  Dual Keres dual swords, with improvements to its damage, critical chance, and status chance. Dual Keres Prime was released alongside  Khora Prime and  Hystrix Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Has a 20% Heavy Attack Efficiency when wielded by  Khora/ Khora Prime.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Carving Mantis,  Crossing Snakes and  Dividing Blades (Conclave only) stance.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high crit chance (32.00%)
High damage × attack speed (340.2)
High block angle (60°)
Very high attack speed (1.250x animation speed)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Very high crit multiplier (2.60x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Very high crit chance (32.00%)
Very high attack speed (1.250x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
High damage × attack speed (680.4)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Very high crit multiplier (2.60x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Very high crit chance (32.00%)
Very high attack speed (1.250x animation speed)
Very high block angle (60°)
High damage × attack speed (1020.6)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Very high crit multiplier (2.60x)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average total damage (180)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.80x))
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Below average total damage (360)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.80x))
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Very low follow through (0.5x)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.80x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.
Comparisons:

 Dual Keres Prime (Normal Attack), compared to  Dual Keres (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage (180.00 vs. 115.00)
Higher  Impact damage ( 21.6 vs.  13.8)
Higher  Puncture damage ( 54 vs.  34.5)
Higher  Slash damage ( 104.4 vs.  66.7)
Higher total damage (180 vs. 115)
Higher base critical chance (32.00% vs. 28.00%)
Higher base status chance (24.00% vs. 14.00%)
Higher Mastery Rank required (14 vs. 7)
Lower disposition (●●○○○ (0.80x) vs. ●●●○○ (1.10x))

Acquisition

Trivia
The Dual Keres Prime, alongside  Afuris Prime, Akarius Prime,  Akbolto Prime,  Aksomati Prime,  Akstiletto Prime,  Ballistica Prime,  Cernos Prime,  Dual Kamas Prime,  Fang Prime,  Gunsen Prime,  Paris Prime and  Zhuge Prime are the only Prime weapons that do not require Orokin Cells as crafting ingredients.
